name: YodlRouter public transferFee pulls approvers' tokens
summary: YodlRouter's transferFee(amount, feeBps, token, from, to) is public and calls transferFrom(from, to, amount * feeBps / 10000) for any from. With feeBps 10000 the attacker pulled the full USDC balances of four users who had approved the router.
notes: The DeFiHackLabs header's ~5k understates the loss: the anchor's four USDC Transfer logs to the attacker sum to 47,809.36 USDC, which the attacker swapped to DAI and kept.

Campaign: the other mainnet YodlRouter deployments with transferFee (0x42ecf398, 0x9179f20b, 0x6c17924f) had no live approvals drained, and campaign.mjs finds no other transferFee call pulling third-party funds from 0xe3a0bc34.
